info.title: LightningRouter L402 funding API
info.description: Optional payment operations, separate from read-only discovery and inference. Obtain user authorization before paying. BTC converts once into USD credits at the locked invoice quote, including the 10% FX buffer. Accounts are created only after verified settlement. Never log API keys or payment proofs.

post.summary: Request an L402 invoice or redeem its payment proof for USD credits
post.description: Send X-API-Key and Idempotency-Key on every call. The initial call has no Authorization header and returns 402. After paying once, repeat the identical request with Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<hex preimage>. For a new account, generate sk-tr-v1- followed by 32 cryptographically random bytes encoded as unpadded base64url, save it securely, and set new_account=true. Never generate another key or purchase ID during retries. Tokens expire after 24 hours, but paid credit does not. Does not accept prompts or authorize inference.

200.description: Verified payment credited exactly once; repeated redemption returns the same receipt

202.description: Payment or credit delivery is pending; retry without paying again

402.description: Pay the existing invoice once, then retry with its payment proof

400.description: Invalid body, amount or idempotency key

401.description: Invalid/revoked API key or invalid/expired L402 proof

409.description: Purchase conflict, expired invoice or another unresolved invoice

410.description: Invoice canceled; no replacement invoice created

413.description: Missing Content-Length or body larger than 1024 bytes

503.description: Unavailable or payment needs review. Do not pay again. Honor Retry-After when present.

FundingKey.name: X-API-Key
FundingKey.description: Destination account key or securely generated new checkout key. Required on initial request and redemption.

L402.description: Use after paying: <macaroon>:<64-character hexadecimal preimage>. Keep X-API-Key and Idempotency-Key unchanged.
